data.headline: Asbury Park agenda identifies Block 3801 redevelopment property

claims.text: The City of Asbury Park City Council agenda lists an ordinance authorizing a financial agreement for property at Block 3801, Lot 1.021 and 320 Asbury Avenue within the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area.

citation.quote: 2026-22 Ordinance Of The City Of Asbury Park Authorizing The Execution Of A Financial Agreement With PHM Drift at Asbury Park Urban Renewal LLC Concerning Property Located At Block 3801, Lot 1.021 (F/K/A Block 3801, a Portion of Lot 1.02) 320 Asbury Avenue On The City Tax Map within the Asbury Park Waterfront Redevelopment Area And Granting A Tax Exemption

claims.text: STHO says it owns remaining development sites in the Asbury Park Waterfront investment.

citation.quote: In addition to the operating assets, we also own remaining development sites.

claims.text: STHO's stated strategy is to monetize remaining development sites and operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting redevelopment-agreement obligations.

citation.quote: Our current strategy for the Asbury Park Waterfront investment is to actively asset manage our operating assets, and strategically monetize the remaining development sites and our operating assets through sales to third party developers and operators while meeting our obligations under the redevelopment agreement with the city of Asbury Park.

claims.text: The Asbury Park Waterfront investment had an aggregate carrying value of approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.

citation.quote: The aggregate carrying value of the Asbury Park Waterfront investment was approximately $120.9 million as of June 30, 2026.
